snippet.title: Through the Nightmares - Official Release Window and Console Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Enjoy the latest trailer for Through the Nightmares, the upcoming ultra-tough platformer that has you suiting up as Sandman to save the children by battling through Morpheus's realm. It's out this June for PC, PS4, PS5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch. You can wishlist it on Steam here if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1266210/Through_the_Nightmares/
